title: MoDDiT: Simple Token Routing in Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: MoDDiT：扩散Transformer中的简易Token路由机制

paragraphs.en: 总结：MoDDiT通过让token动态路由经过MLP和自注意力模块，实现扩散Transformer的自适应算力分配，仅需处理12.5%的token即可降低训练与推理成本并提升生成质量。 Real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis are almost a reality. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve excellent sample quality, shifting the bottleneck to the throughput of the models themselves. Natural images are inherently sparse, as large portions of an image are often background, contribute little to the scene content, and are easy to denoise. DiTs fail to exploit this sparsity, as they process image tokens statically and uniformly. We propose MoDDiT, a simple architecture modification that learns to route tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations. By routing tokens through both blocks independently, MoDDiT allows for dynamic compute allocation in MLPs that varies across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps. Using MoDDiT to train image generation models from scratch significantly reduces computational costs of training and inference, processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens. By increasing sparsity and model depth, MoDDiT reduces costs and improves generation performance over unrouted baselines. The learned allocation is interpretable, revealing how computation varies with visual content and noise level. We also use MoDDiT to train video generation models, where allocation correlates with motion, and to distill a dense bidirectional video model into a sparse autoregressive student.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：MoDDiT通过让token动态路由经过MLP和自注意力模块，实现扩散Transformer的自适应算力分配，仅需处理12.5%的token即可降低训练与推理成本并提升生成质量。实时视频生成、交互式世界模型和端侧图像合成几乎已成为现实。 扩散Transformer（DiT）实现了出色的样本质量，从而将瓶颈转移到了模型自身的吞吐量上。 自然图像本质上是稀疏的，因为图像的很大一部分往往是背景，对场景内容的贡献很小，且易于去噪。 DiT未能利用这种稀疏性，因为它们静态且均匀地处理图像token。 我们提出MoDDiT，这是一种简单的架构修改，它学习将token路由经过MLP和自注意力两种操作。 通过让token独立地路由经过这两种模块，MoDDiT实现了MLP中的动态算力分配，该分配在不同token、不同图像和不同去噪时间步之间有所变化。 使用MoDDiT从头训练图像生成模型可显著降低训练和推理的计算成本，仅需处理少至12.5%的token。 通过提高稀疏度和模型深度，MoDDiT相比无路由的基线降低了成本并提升了生成性能。 学到的分配是可解释的，揭示了计算量如何随视觉内容和噪声水平而变化。 我们还使用MoDDiT训练视频生成模型（其中算力分配与运动相关联），并将一个密集的双向视频模型蒸馏为一个稀疏的自回归学生模型。
